prompt: What was the last prose book written by the poet who referred to Wyndham Lewis as "that lonely old volcano of the Right."?
answer: The poet was **W. H. Auden**, whose last major prose book was **_A Certain World: A Commonplace Book_ (1970)**. His posthumous/final collection, **_Forewords and Afterwords_**, was published in 1973.
